featuredResource.title: Northeastern Forest Products Supply Chain Climate Adaptation Toolkit
featuredResource.description: This online toolkit organizes climate-adaptation options for northeastern landowners, foresters, loggers and mills. It connects operating challenges with practical actions in harvest scheduling, roads, water-quality practices, wood procurement and related areas.
